title: Record death-save saving-throw bonus in a structured event, not only the tool result
description: eshyra-o9bd.19.6.7.6.1 accepts saveBonus/bonusSources on record_death_save and returns them in the tool result (and on the combatant lifecycle event). Mutation provenance is a plain string and there is no durable structured death-save event payload, so the bonus is not persisted per save. Decide whether death-save events need a structured record (provenance/event schema change) before relying on the bonus for audit replay.
